label: Product journey
about: Is there a clear core journey that solves the stated problem end to end? Onboarding, flow, does the demo match the product.

label: Real-world value
about: Does it solve a real problem for real users? How big is the impact if it works?

label: UI / UX
about: Clarity, polish, accessibility, works on phone and laptop.

label: Code quality
about: Readable, well-structured code; sensible architecture; error handling; tests that mean something.

label: SDLC practices
about: Commit history, tests and CI, docs, deploy process, honest scoping of what was built at the event.

label: Feasibility
about: Can this actually ship and run? Dependencies, risks, what breaks first.

label: Scalability
about: Will it hold up with more users, data or chains? Where are the limits?

label: Business model
about: Who pays, why, and is it sustainable? Public goods may explain sustainability without revenue.

label: Brownie points
about: Extra credit as this judge defines it (see their brownie points).
